svg.aria-label: LogForge-SIEM log stream and detection alert icon
svg.title: Logs enter, match a detection, and produce an alert
svg.desc: Square LogForge-SIEM identity using the midnight navy base, slate brand panels, and amber highlight. Three white log rows flow toward an amber warning triangle. The repeated rows represent normalized events; the alert marker represents a detection-rule match. At small sizes, the amber event marker and stacked log strokes remain the primary silhouette.
